residentialProxy.title: Static Residential Proxy
residentialProxy.description: A proxy service based on real residential networks, providing fixed IP addresses that remain unchanged for long periods. With high anonymity and credibility, it effectively avoids being identified as a proxy or being blocked, suitable for cross-border e-commerce, market research, social media marketing, brand protection, and various other business scenarios.

dynamicProxy.title: Dynamic Residential Proxy
dynamicProxy.description: A proxy service based on a constantly changing IP address pool, providing IP addresses that change frequently within short periods. This service offers high flexibility and extensive IP coverage, effectively avoiding IP bans and restrictions, suitable for scenarios requiring frequent IP changes such as web crawling, data scraping, ad verification, and automated testing.

dataCenterProxy.title: Static Data Center Proxy
dataCenterProxy.description: A proxy service based on data center networks, providing fixed IP addresses that remain unchanged for long periods. This proxy service delivers IPs through data center servers, typically offering high speed and stability, with advantages in cost and performance. Particularly suitable for business scenarios requiring fast, large-scale data scraping and access, such as website testing, data analysis, SEO monitoring, and online ad verification.
